title: Turner 2008 FDA-versus-journal antidepressant audit: publication bias can change apparent efficacy
summary: An FDA/journal audit-pair record: compare all FDA-visible antidepressant efficacy trials with the journal numerator available to clinicians. The record demonstrates that the literature can change both the apparent fraction of positive studies and effect-size estimates.

status_history.note: Promoted in rev0009 as a reporting-bias / file-drawer audit record.

place.scope: 12 antidepressant agents / FDA approval packages / journal publications

claims.claim: Turner et al. 2008 compared FDA review documents for antidepressant trials with corresponding journal publications, giving the cube a concrete audit-pair method: regulator-visible trial denominator versus published literature numerator.
